facts.text: Quail Springs Mall opened March 1, 1980, covering 1,115,000 sq ft and drew crowds from far‑flung Oklahoma City.
The mall’s original architect was William Pereira, famed for designing the Transamerica Pyramid.
In 1998 a multimillion‑dollar makeover turned the interior into an Oklahoma prairie theme and added a 24‑screen AMC Theatre.
Life Time Fitness, the former Macy’s upper level, opened in October 2018, turning a retail space into a community fitness hub.
Quail Springs Mall’s location near the congested intersection of West Memorial Road, North Pennsylvania Avenue and The Kilpatrick Turnpike made it a focal point for regional development.
The mall’s original four anchors included JCPenney, Sears, Foley’s (later Macy’s) and Dillard’s, but by 2016 only three remained.
